name: gntc-labs
description: GNTC Labs — agent skills and plugins for GNTC's products (VibeHost, EntryDesk, Dock)

plugins.name: vibehost
plugins.description: VibeHost's MCP server plus agent skills — deploy, share, and manage static sites from the VibeHost CLI or MCP tools, plus two Halloween games you can publish in one prompt: a pumpkin patch and a team haunted farm.

plugins.name: entrydesk
plugins.description: Agent skills for EntryDesk — chat with AI models and agents, schedule agents, and call connected SaaS tools (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, …) from the terminal.

plugins.name: dock-space
plugins.description: Dock's MCP server plus the deck skills Dock's own agent uses: plan a presentation, build it from documents or web research, place charts and pictures, give it a visual style, and check the rendered slides before handing it over.
